stdout:
usage: jef-data [-h] command ...

EOD data layer

positional arguments:
  command
    validate    validate a CSV against the EOD input contract
    sync-actions
                sync a symbol's splits and dividends
    load        hand-run EODHD load of one symbol
    adjust      re-derive a series from its raw columns
    import-csv  import a Yahoo CSV as a whole series
    export      write a series' seam frame as CSV
    differential
                compare two series within a tolerance
    sync        run the universe's acquisition legs
    status      read-only health verdicts of the store
    universe    list the universe

options:
  -h, --help    show this help message and exit
